text: The purpose of this report is to provide Council with the City of Toronto's Operating Variance results for the year ended December 31, 2018 and the disposition of the 2018 year-end operating surplus. As of December 31, 2018 the City experienced a favourable variance of $147.200 million net. City Council on July 16, 17 and 18, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the transfer of $8.000 million from the Water (43 percent) and Wastewater (57 percent) Stabilization Reserves to Toronto Water's Vehicle and Equipment Replacement Reserve (XQ1012) to fund future year vehicle purchases. 2. City Council approve the withdrawal from Emergency Human Services Reserve (XQ1111) of $0.077 million to supplement funding in the Emergency Human Services Expense Account to mitigate the deficit position in 2018.
